description.ja: 欧米諸国でも高い人気を誇るアニメ『鋼鉄ジーグ』の主役機「鋼鉄ジーグ」が、アレンジシリーズ「INFINITISM」第四弾として登場！
description.en: The main character "Kotetsu Jeeg " from the anime " Kotetsu Jeeg ", which is very popular in Western countries, is now available as the fourth installment of the arrangement series " INFINITISM"!

description.ja: ■メカデザイナー柳瀬敬之氏デザインアレンジ。頭長高175mmにINFINITISMの世界観を盛り込むことに成功。
description.en: • Designed and arranged by mechanical designer Noriyuki Yanase. Succeeded in incorporating INFINITISM's world view into a head length of 175mm.

description.ja: ■ギミックや細部の作り込みなど、プラモデルオリジナルアレンジも搭載。
description.en: • Equipped with original plastic model arrangements such as gimmicks and detailed details.

description.ja: ■マッハドリル装備時の全高は230mm超となる大型キット。
description.en: • A large kit with a total height of over 230mm when equipped with a Mach drill.

description.ja: ■シールを使わず、組み立てるだけでカラフルな仕上がり。
description.en: • Colorful finish with just assembly without using seals.

description.ja: ■アクションベース付属で飛行状態での展示が可能。
description.en: • Comes with an action base so it can be displayed in flight.

description.ja: ■両手指を組んだナックルボンバー再現パーツとエフェクトも同梱。
description.en: • Knuckle Bomber reproduction parts and effects are also included.

accessories.ja: 横向き飛行ポーズ再現パーツ×1
accessories.en: Sideways flight pose reproduction parts x 1

accessories.ja: ナックルボンバーエフェクト×1
ハンドパーツ×4（握り手・左右/開き手・右/ナックルボンバー手×1式）
accessories.en: Hand parts x 4 (grip hand, left and right/open hand, right/knuckle bomber hand x 1 set)
